explanation: With u=5x-3, x=(u+3)/5 and dx=du/5; the limits become -3 and 7. Thus the transformed expression is (1/25)∫ from -3 to 7 of (u^{3/2}+3u^{1/2})du, option b. This is the valid substitution; both expressions require a complex square-root interpretation on part of their intervals, since the original integrand is not real-valued for x<3/5.
